title: LexiTestIdRegistry
description: .lexi/testids.json in each rebuild repo — the machine-readable registry of every test id the app exposes, kept in sync with the code in the same PR. Downstream this parameterises the Maestro/e2e selector allowlist so validators never guess selectors.

appId.description: Application id, mobile platforms only (e.g. com.example.app).

generatedAtSha.description: Commit SHA the registry was last regenerated against. Empty string only in the pre-scaffold skeleton.

screens.description: Screen slug -> the test ids that screen exposes.

prefixes.description: Allowed test-id prefixes (screen slugs), for validator allowlisting.

safeLabels.description: Human-visible labels that are safe for selector fallback (never product copy invented by an agent).
